notices.title: Notice Regarding 340B Rebate Model Pilot Program
notices.summary: Opens a revised 340B Rebate Model Pilot Program. From January 1, 2027, drug makers with an approved plan may give the 340B price as a rebate after the sale, not as a discount up front, on the drugs selected for Medicare price negotiation for 2026 and 2027.
notices.quote: … DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES Health Resources and Services Administration Notice Regarding 340B Rebate Model Pilot Program AGENCY: Health Resources and Services Administration (HRSA), Department of Health and Human Services (HHS). ACTION: Notice. …
notices.dates: Eligible manufacturers seeking to participate in the 340B Rebate Model Pilot Program must submit plans to 340BPricing@hrsa.gov no later than August 24, 2026, for an effective date of January 1, 2027, for selected drugs for initial price applicability year 2026 and 2027 during their price applicability periods.
